text: {"grades": [{"area": "contact", "level": "flag", "reason": "Multiple parents and a Reddit reporter say strangers can message or voice-chat a 9-year-old on Roblox and the parental controls meant to block them do not work in practice.", "setting": "", "findings": ["F1", "F16", "F30", "F105"]}, {"area": "money", "level": "ok_with_setting", "reason": "Roblox pushes loot boxes and in-app purchases at children, but parents can set monthly spending limits or block spending entirely through parental controls.", "setting": "monthly spending restrictions and parental controls to block spending entirely", "findings": ["F179", "F146", "F171", "F154"]}, {"area": "data", "level": "flag", "reason": "Roblox's own terms say it may sell children's data and does not allow full deletion, and the Texas Attorney General has sued the company over its data and safety practices.", "setting": "", "findings": ["F42", "F53", "F143", "F176"]}, {"area": "age_gating", "level": "flag", "reason": "Parents report that the age gate misidentifies young children as adults, leaves them in inappropriate age groups, and does not remove scary or adult content from their view.", "setting": "", "findings": ["F6", "F32", "F83", "F172"]}, {"area": "developer_record", "level": "flag", "reason": "The Texas Attorney General has sued Roblox for allegedly ignoring child-safety laws and deceiving parents, and other sources report regulatory scrutiny over data and age-gating practices.", "setting": "", "findings": ["F43", "F176", "F72"]}]}
